# Data for File 3. Data Exploration
```{r}
# for runtime logging
file_1_start <- Sys.time()
runtime_checkpoints <- c(file_1_start)

print_checkpoint_runtime <- function(current_time) {
  last_checkpoint <- max(runtime_checkpoints)
  runtime_checkpoints <<- c(runtime_checkpoints, current_time)
  
  print(paste('Runtime to checkpoint ', length(runtime_checkpoints) - 1, ': ', 
              format(current_time - last_checkpoint), sep=''))
}
```

# Load the Cleaned Collisions Data
```{r}
collisions_cleaned <- read.csv('Cleaned Data/LACollisionsDataByZIPCode.csv') %>%
  mutate(
    COVIDPeriod = COVIDPeriod %>% factor(levels=c('Pre-COVID', 'During COVID', 'Post-COVID')),
    ReportedDate = as.Date(ReportedDate, format='%Y-%m-%d'),
    OccurredDate = as.Date(OccurredDate, format='%Y-%m-%d'),
  ) %>% filter(OccurredDate >= '2013-01-01', OccurredDate < '2025-01-01')
```

# Breakdown of Fields
## Time series graphs
```{r}
collisions_by_reported <- collisions_cleaned %>% 
  group_by(ReportedDate) %>% summarise(Collisions = n())
collisions_by_occurred <- collisions_cleaned %>% 
  group_by(OccurredDate) %>% summarise(Collisions = n())

collisions_by_reported_by_week <- collisions_cleaned %>% 
  group_by(ReportedDate = floor_date(ReportedDate, unit='weeks')) %>% 
  summarise(Collisions = n())
collisions_by_occurred_by_week <- collisions_cleaned %>% 
  group_by(OccurredDate = floor_date(OccurredDate, unit='weeks')) %>% 
  summarise(Collisions = n())
```

## Scatterplot of Latitude, Longitude, 
```{r, fig.width=6, fig.height=3.5}
rounding_factor <- 100

collisions_by_coordinates_and_year <- collisions_cleaned %>% 
  group_by(Latitude, Longitude, OccurredYear = year(OccurredDate)) %>% 
  summarise(Collisions = n()) %>% 
  group_by(Latitude = floor(Latitude*local(rounding_factor))/local(rounding_factor), 
           Longitude = floor(Longitude*local(rounding_factor))/local(rounding_factor),
           OccurredYear) %>% 
  summarise(TotalCollisions = sum(Collisions),
            AvgCollisionsPerLocation = mean(Collisions, na.rm=TRUE),
            StanDevCollisions = sd(Collisions),
            NumLocations = n()) %>%
  filter(Latitude != 0 | Longitude != 0)

print_checkpoint_runtime(Sys.time())
```

# Identifying Collision Hot Spots
```{r}
rounding_factor <- 100

collisions_by_location_2024 <- collisions_cleaned %>%
  mutate(OccurredYear = year(OccurredDate)) %>%
  filter(OccurredYear == 2024) %>%
  group_by(Address, CrossStreet, Latitude, Longitude) %>% 
  summarise(Collisions = n()) %>% 
  group_by(Latitude = round(Latitude*local(rounding_factor))/local(rounding_factor), 
           Longitude = round(Longitude*local(rounding_factor))/local(rounding_factor)) %>% 
  summarise(TotalCollisions = sum(Collisions),
            AvgCollisionsPerLocation = mean(Collisions, na.rm=TRUE),
            NumCollisionRecords = n(),
            RangeOfCollisions = max(Collisions) - min(Collisions),
            StdCollisions = sd(Collisions)
            ) %>%
  filter(Latitude != 0 | Longitude != 0)
```

# Collision Object
```{r}
collisions_by_object <- collisions_cleaned %>%
    filter(CollisionWithVehicle) %>%
    mutate(CollisionObject = 'Vehicle') %>% 
  rbind(
    collisions_cleaned %>%
      filter(CollisionWithParkedVehicle) %>%
      mutate(CollisionObject = 'Parked Vehicle')
  ) %>% 
  rbind(
    collisions_cleaned %>%
      filter(CollisionWithFixedObject) %>%
      mutate(CollisionObject = 'Fixed Object')
  ) %>% 
  rbind(
    collisions_cleaned %>%
      filter(CollisionWithPedestrian) %>%
      mutate(CollisionObject = 'Pedestrian')
  ) %>% 
  rbind(
    collisions_cleaned %>%
      filter(CollisionWithBike) %>%
      mutate(CollisionObject = 'Bike') 
  ) %>% 
  rbind(
    collisions_cleaned %>%
      filter(CollisionWithMotorcycle) %>%
      mutate(CollisionObject = 'Motorcycle')
  ) %>% 
  rbind(
    collisions_cleaned %>%
      filter(CollisionWithOtherObject) %>%
      mutate(CollisionObject = 'Other') 
  ) %>% 
  select(CollisionObject, OccurredDate, OccurredYear, Latitude, Longitude, 
         CollisionAtIntersection, InjuryInvolved, MostSevereInjuryReported,
         NonInjury, ComplaintOfInjury, VisibleInjury, SevereInjury, FatalInjury) %>%
  mutate(CollisionObject = factor(CollisionObject, levels=c('Bike', 'Fixed Object', 'Motorcycle',
                                                             'Parked Vehicle', 'Pedestrian',
                                                             'Vehicle', 'Other')))

print_checkpoint_runtime(Sys.time())
```

# Defining Functions for Future Analysis
```{r}
intro_graphs <- function(graph_data, field_name, label=field_name, text_size=11) {
  # rename column
  graph_data <- graph_data %>% 
    rename(TargetFeature = as.symbol(local(field_name)))
  
  # histogram
  print(graph_data %>%
          filter(OccurredYear != 2020, OccurredYear >= 2016) %>%
          group_by(COVIDPeriod) %>%
          mutate(TotalCollisions = n()) %>% ungroup() %>%
          group_by(COVIDPeriod, TargetFeature) %>%
          summarise(Collisions = n(),
                    Proportion = Collisions/first(TotalCollisions)) %>%
          ggplot(aes(x=TargetFeature, y=Proportion, fill=TargetFeature)) +
          geom_bar(stat='identity') +
          theme_set(theme_gray(base_size = text_size)) +
          theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank()) +
          labs(x=local(label), y='Proportion of Collisions', fill='') +
          scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
          facet_wrap(~COVIDPeriod) +
          ggtitle(paste('Distribution of Collisions by ', label, sep=''),
                  subtitle='Pre- vs Post-COVID'))
  
  # number over time
  print(graph_data %>%
          filter(OccurredDate >= '2013-01-01',
                 OccurredDate < '2025-03-01') %>%
          group_by(OccurredDate = floor_date(OccurredDate, unit='months'), TargetFeature) %>%
          summarise(Collisions = n()) %>%
          ggplot(aes(x=OccurredDate, y=Collisions, color=TargetFeature)) +
          geom_line() +
          labs(x='Date of Collisions', y='Collisions', color='') +
          theme_set(theme_gray(base_size = text_size)) +
          ggtitle(paste('Number of Collisions over Time by', label)))
  
  # rate over time
  print(graph_data %>%
          filter(OccurredDate >= '2013-01-01',
                 OccurredDate < '2025-03-01') %>%
          group_by(OccurredDate = floor_date(OccurredDate, unit='months')) %>%
          mutate(TotalCollisions = n()) %>% ungroup() %>%
          group_by(OccurredDate, TargetFeature) %>%
          summarise(Proportion = n()/first(TotalCollisions)) %>%
          ggplot(aes(x=OccurredDate, y=Proportion, color=TargetFeature)) +
          geom_line() +
          labs(x='Date of Collisions', y='Proportion of Collisions', color='') + 
          scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
          theme_set(theme_gray(base_size = text_size)) +
          ggtitle(paste('Proportion of Collisions over Time by', label)))
}

mapping_hotspots <- function(graph_data, field_name, label=field_name, 
                             high_percentile=95, text_size=11, dot_size=2) {
  # rename column
  graph_data <- graph_data %>% 
    filter(OccurredYear != 2020, OccurredYear >= 2016) %>%
    rename(TargetFeature = as.symbol(local(field_name)))
  
  grouped_data <- graph_data %>%
    filter(CollisionAtIntersection == 1,
           Latitude != 0, Longitude != 0) %>%
    group_by(Latitude, Longitude) %>%
    summarise(
      Collisions = n(),
      TargetFeatureRate = round(mean(TargetFeature), 2),
      TargetFeatureCount = sum(TargetFeature)) %>%
    filter(Collisions > local(collision_threshold))

  feature_percentiles <- grouped_data %>%
    group_by(1) %>%
    mutate(CountNTile = ntile(TargetFeatureCount, 100),
           RateNTile = ntile(TargetFeatureRate, 100)) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  count_regression <- lm(TargetFeatureCount ~ Collisions, data=grouped_data)
  count_percentile <- (feature_percentiles %>% 
                        filter(CountNTile == local(high_percentile)) %>% 
                        summarise(Threshold = min(TargetFeatureCount)))$Threshold[1]
  rate_percentile <- (feature_percentiles %>% 
                        filter(RateNTile == local(high_percentile)) %>% 
                        summarise(Threshold = min(TargetFeatureRate)))$Threshold[1]

  # scatterplor of collisions by intersection
  print(
    grouped_data %>%
      arrange(desc(TargetFeatureCount)) %>%
      ggplot(aes(x=Collisions, y=TargetFeatureCount)) + geom_point() + 
      geom_abline(intercept=local(coefficients(count_regression))[1], 
                  slope=local(coefficients(count_regression))[2], linetype='dashed') +
      labs(x=paste('Collisions Involving ', label, sep=''), y='Number of Intersections') +
      theme_set(theme_gray(base_size = text_size)) +
      ggtitle(paste('Number of Collisions Involving ', label, ' by Intersection, ', year_label, sep=''),
              subtitle=paste('Average rate of  ', label, ' per collision: ', 
                             round(local(coefficients(count_regression))[2], 4), sep=''))
  )
  
  # histogram of rates by intersection
  print(
    grouped_data %>%
      arrange(desc(TargetFeatureRate)) %>%
      ggplot(aes(x=TargetFeatureRate)) +
      geom_histogram(bins=25) +
      geom_vline(xintercept=local(rate_percentile), linetype='dashed') +
      scale_x_continuous(labels=scales::percent) +
      labs(x=paste('Rate of Collisions Involving ', label, sep=''), y='Number of Intersections') +
      theme_set(theme_gray(base_size = text_size)) +
      ggtitle(paste('Rate of Collisions Involving ', label, ' by Intersection, ', year_label, sep=''),
              subtitle=paste(high_percentile, 'th Percentile: ', rate_percentile*100, '%', sep=''))
  )

  # mapping hotspots
  print(
    grouped_data %>%
      mutate(
        Hotspot = factor(case_when(
          TargetFeatureCount >= local(count_percentile) & 
            TargetFeatureRate >= local(rate_percentile) ~ 'High Rate and Volume',
          TargetFeatureCount >= local(count_percentile) ~ 'High Volume',
          TargetFeatureRate >= local(rate_percentile) ~ 'High Rate',
          TRUE ~ 'Not a Hotspot'
        ), levels=c('High Rate and Volume', 'High Volume', 'High Rate', 'Not a Hotspot'))
      ) %>%
      arrange(desc(Hotspot)) %>%
      ggplot(aes(x=Longitude, y=Latitude, color=Hotspot)) +
      geom_point(size=dot_size) +
      labs(x='', y='', color='') +
      theme_set(theme_gray(base_size = text_size)) +
      ggtitle(paste('Map of Hotspots for Collisions Involving ', label, ', ', year_label, sep=''))
  )
}

graphing_variable_distributions <- function(graph_data, field1, field2, label1=field1, label2=field2, text_size=11) {
  # rename column
  graph_data <- graph_data %>% 
    filter(OccurredYear != 2020, OccurredYear >= 2016) %>%
    rename(TargetFeature1 = as.symbol(local(field1)),
           TargetFeature2 = as.symbol(local(field2)))

  ## distribution of injury type by feature, pre-COVID
  print(
    graph_data %>%
      filter(COVIDPeriod == 'Pre-COVID') %>%
      group_by(TargetFeature1) %>%
      mutate(TotalCollisions = n()) %>% ungroup() %>%
      group_by(TargetFeature1, TargetFeature2) %>%
      summarise(Proportion = n()/first(TotalCollisions)) %>%
      ggplot(aes(x=TargetFeature2, y=Proportion, fill=TargetFeature2)) +
      geom_bar(stat='identity', position='dodge') +
      labs(x='', y='Proportion of Collisions', fill=label2) +
      scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent, limits = c(0, 1)) +
      facet_wrap(~TargetFeature1) +
      theme_set(theme_gray(base_size = text_size)) +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank()) +
      ggtitle(paste('Distribution of ', label2, ' by ', label1, sep=''),
              subtitle='Pre-COVID')
  )
  
  ## distribution of injury type by feature, post-COVID
  print(
    graph_data %>%
      filter(COVIDPeriod == 'Post-COVID') %>%
      group_by(TargetFeature1) %>%
      mutate(TotalCollisions = n()) %>% ungroup() %>%
      group_by(TargetFeature1, TargetFeature2) %>%
      summarise(Proportion = n()/first(TotalCollisions)) %>%
      ggplot(aes(x=TargetFeature2, y=Proportion, fill=TargetFeature2)) +
      geom_bar(stat='identity', position='dodge') +
      labs(x='', y='Proportion of Collisions', fill=label2) +
      scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent, limits = c(0, 1)) +
      facet_wrap(~TargetFeature1) +
      theme_set(theme_gray(base_size = text_size)) +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank()) +
      ggtitle(paste('Distribution of ', label2, ' by ', label1, sep=''),
              subtitle='Post-COVID')
  )
  
  ## distribution of feature by injury type, pre-COVID
  print(
    graph_data %>%
      filter(COVIDPeriod == 'Pre-COVID') %>%
      group_by(TargetFeature2) %>%
      mutate(TotalCollisions = n()) %>% ungroup() %>%
      group_by(TargetFeature1, TargetFeature2) %>%
      summarise(Proportion = n()/first(TotalCollisions)) %>%
      ggplot(aes(x=TargetFeature1, y=Proportion, fill=TargetFeature1)) +
      geom_bar(stat='identity', position = position_dodge2(width = 0.9, preserve = "single")) +
      labs(x='', y='Proportion of Collisions', fill=label1) +
      scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent, limits = c(0, 1)) +
      facet_wrap(~TargetFeature2) +
      theme_set(theme_gray(base_size = text_size)) +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank()) +
      ggtitle(paste('Distribution of ', label1, ' Causes by ', label2, sep=''),
              subtitle='Pre-COVID')
  )
  
  ## distribution of feature by injury type, pre-COVID
  print(
    graph_data %>%
      filter(COVIDPeriod == 'Post-COVID') %>%
       group_by(TargetFeature2) %>%
      mutate(TotalCollisions = n()) %>% ungroup() %>%
      group_by(TargetFeature1, TargetFeature2) %>%
      summarise(Proportion = n()/first(TotalCollisions)) %>%
      ggplot(aes(x=TargetFeature1, y=Proportion, fill=TargetFeature1)) +
      geom_bar(stat='identity', position = position_dodge2(width = 0.9, preserve = "single")) +
      labs(x='', y='Proportion of Collisions', fill=label1) +
      scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent, limits = c(0, 1)) +
      facet_wrap(~TargetFeature2) +
      theme_set(theme_gray(base_size = text_size)) +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank()) +
      ggtitle(paste('Distribution of ', label1, ' Causes by ', label2, sep=''),
              subtitle='Post-COVID')
  )
}

  print_checkpoint_runtime(Sys.time())
```

## Proportion of collisions w/ conflicting MO codes over time
```{r}
check_multi_substring <- function(patterns, text) {
  count <- 0
  
  for (pattern in unique(patterns)) {
    count <- count + as.numeric(grepl(as.character(pattern), text))
  }
  
  return(as.numeric(count > 1))
}

collisions_mo_code_conflicts <- collisions_cleaned %>% 
  mutate(
    ConflictingIntersection = check_multi_substring(c(3037, 3036), MOCodes),
    ConflictingCityProperty = check_multi_substring(c(3035, 3034), MOCodes),
    ConflictingPrivateProperty = check_multi_substring(c(3033, 3032), MOCodes),
    ConflictingDUI = check_multi_substring(c(3039, 3038), MOCodes),
    ConflictingHitAndRun = check_multi_substring(c(3030, 3029), MOCodes),
    ConflictingInjury = check_multi_substring(c(3028, 3027, 3026, 3025, 3024), MOCodes),
    ConflictingRegion = check_multi_substring(c(4027, 4026, 4025, 4024), MOCodes),
    ConflictingPCF = check_multi_substring(c(3104, 3103, 3102), MOCodes),
    ConflictingLocation = check_multi_substring(c(4001:4021), MOCodes),
    ConflictingMOCodes = ConflictingIntersection == 1 |
      ConflictingCityProperty == 1 | ConflictingPrivateProperty == 1 |
      ConflictingDUI == 1 | ConflictingHitAndRun == 1 | 
      ConflictingInjury == 1 | ConflictingRegion == 1 |
      ConflictingPCF == 1 | ConflictingLocation == 1,
    IncompleteMOCodes = MostSevereInjuryReported == 'Unspecified' |
      MostVulnerableCollisionObject == 'Unspecified' | 
      (!AtIntersection & !NotAtIntersection)
  )

print_checkpoint_runtime(Sys.time())
```

# Data for File 5. Demographic Trends

```{r}
census_data <- read.csv('Cleaned Data/LAGeneralDemographicsByZIPCode.csv')
```

```{r}
api_data_renames <- read.csv('Cleaned Data/APIDataFieldNameTranslations.csv')

census_data_long_by_zip <- census_data %>% pivot_longer(
  colnames(census_data)[3:dim(census_data)[2]], names_to='FieldName', values_to='Population'
) %>% left_join(api_data_renames, by='FieldName') %>% 
  group_by(Year, ZIPCode, DemographicType, Demographic) %>% 
  summarise(Population = sum(Population, na.rm=TRUE)) %>%
  mutate(CountPopulation = ifelse(Demographic %in% c('Male', 'Female'), Population, 0)) %>%
  group_by(Year, ZIPCode) %>% mutate(TotalPopulation = sum(CountPopulation)) %>% ungroup() %>%
  select(Year, ZIPCode, DemographicType, Demographic, Population, TotalPopulation)

census_data_overall_long <- census_data_long_by_zip %>% 
  group_by(Year, DemographicType, Demographic) %>% 
  summarise(Population = sum(Population, na.rm=TRUE),
            TotalPopulation = sum(TotalPopulation, na.rm=TRUE))
```

# Commutes over Time
## Commuting shifts after COVID
```{r}
commuting_data <- read.csv('Cleaned Data/LACommutingDataGeneralAndSexByZIPCode.csv')

commuting_data_long_by_zip <- commuting_data %>%
  pivot_longer(colnames(commuting_data)[3:dim(commuting_data)[2]], 
               names_to='FieldName', values_to='Commuters') %>%
  left_join(api_data_renames, by='FieldName') %>% 
  mutate(CountCommuters = ifelse(
    !(CommuterType %in% c('Approximate Number of Cars', 'Non-Car', 'Total')) &
      Demographic == 'Total Population', Commuters, 0)) %>%
  group_by(Year, ZIPCode) %>% mutate(TotalCommuters = sum(CountCommuters, na.rm=TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup() %>% select(Year, ZIPCode, FieldName, Commuters, Demographic, DemographicType,
                       CommuterType, CommuterTypeGroup, TotalCommuters)

commuting_data_long <- commuting_data_long_by_zip %>% 
  filter(Demographic == 'Total Population') %>%
  group_by(Year, CommuterType) %>%
  summarise(Commuters = sum(Commuters, na.rm=TRUE),
            TotalCommuters = sum(TotalCommuters, na.rm=TRUE))

commuting_data_by_sex_long_by_zip <- commuting_data_long_by_zip %>% 
  filter(Demographic != 'Total Population', CommuterType != 'Total') %>%
  mutate(CountCommuters = ifelse(
    !(CommuterType %in% c('Approximate Number of Cars', 'Non-Car')), Commuters, 0)) %>%
  group_by(Year, Demographic, ZIPCode) %>% 
  mutate(DemographicCommuters = sum(CountCommuters, na.rm=TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup() %>% select(Year, ZIPCode, FieldName, Commuters, Demographic, CommuterType, 
                       CommuterTypeGroup, DemographicCommuters, TotalCommuters)

commuting_data_by_sex_long <- commuting_data_by_sex_long_by_zip %>%
  group_by(Year, Demographic, CommuterType) %>%
  summarise(Commuters = sum(Commuters, na.rm=TRUE),
            TotalCommuters = sum(TotalCommuters, na.rm=TRUE),
            DemographicCommuters = sum(DemographicCommuters, na.rm=TRUE))
  
```

```{r}
               names_to='FieldName', values_to='Commuters') %>%
  left_join(api_data_renames, by='FieldName') %>% 
  mutate(CountCommuters = ifelse(
    !(CommuterType %in% c('Approximate Number of Cars', 'Non-Car')), Commuters, 0)) %>%
  group_by(Year, Demographic, ZIPCode) %>% mutate(DemographicCommuters = sum(CountCommuters, na.rm=TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup() %>% select(Year, ZIPCode, FieldName, Commuters, Demographic, CommuterType, 
                       CommuterTypeGroup, DemographicCommuters)
  
commuting_data_by_age_long <- commuting_data_by_age_long_by_zip %>%
  group_by(Year, Demographic, CommuterType) %>%
  summarise(Commuters = sum(Commuters, na.rm=TRUE),
            DemographicCommuters = sum(DemographicCommuters, na.rm=TRUE))

commuting_data_by_ethnicity_long_by_zip <- commuting_data_by_ethnicity %>%
  pivot_longer(colnames(commuting_data_by_ethnicity)[3:dim(commuting_data_by_ethnicity)[2]], 
               names_to='FieldName', values_to='Commuters') %>%
  left_join(api_data_renames, by='FieldName') %>% 
  mutate(CountCommuters = ifelse(
    !(CommuterType %in% c('Approximate Number of Cars', 'Non-Car')), Commuters, 0)) %>%
  group_by(Year, Demographic, ZIPCode) %>% mutate(DemographicCommuters = sum(CountCommuters, na.rm=TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup() %>% select(Year, ZIPCode, FieldName, Commuters, Demographic, CommuterType, 
                       CommuterTypeGroup, DemographicCommuters)
  
commuting_data_by_ethnicity_long <- commuting_data_by_ethnicity_long_by_zip %>%
  group_by(Year, Demographic, CommuterType) %>%
  summarise(Commuters = sum(Commuters, na.rm=TRUE),
            DemographicCommuters = sum(DemographicCommuters, na.rm=TRUE))
```

# Occupations over Time
## Occupation shifts after COVID
```{r}
occupations_data <- read.csv('Cleaned Data/LAWorkerOccupationsOverallByZIPCode.csv')
occupations_data_by_ethnicity <- read.csv('Cleaned Data/LAWorkerOccupationsRaceEthnicityByZIPCode.csv')

occupations_data_long_by_zip <- occupations_data %>%
  pivot_longer(colnames(occupations_data)[3:dim(occupations_data)[2]], 
               names_to='FieldName', values_to='Workers') %>%
  left_join(api_data_renames, by='FieldName') %>% 
  mutate(CountWorkers = ifelse(grepl('Industry', FieldName), Workers, 0)) %>%
  group_by(Year, ZIPCode) %>% mutate(TotalWorkers = sum(CountWorkers, na.rm=TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup() %>% select(Year, ZIPCode, FieldName, Workers, Demographic, 
                       WorkerType, WorkerIndustryType, WorkerClassType, TotalWorkers)

occupations_data_long <- occupations_data_long_by_zip %>%
  group_by(Year, WorkerType, WorkerIndustryType, WorkerClassType) %>%
  summarise(Workers = sum(Workers, na.rm=TRUE),
            TotalWorkers = sum(TotalWorkers, na.rm=TRUE))

occupations_data_by_ethnicity_long_by_zip <- occupations_data_by_ethnicity %>%
  pivot_longer(colnames(occupations_data_by_ethnicity)[3:dim(occupations_data_by_ethnicity)[2]], 
               names_to='FieldName', values_to='Workers') %>%
  left_join(api_data_renames, by='FieldName') %>% 
  filter(WorkerType != '') %>%
  group_by(Year, Demographic, ZIPCode) %>% mutate(DemographicWorkers = sum(Workers, na.rm=TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup() %>% select(Year, ZIPCode, FieldName, Workers, Demographic, WorkerType, DemographicWorkers)

occupations_data_by_ethnicity_long <- occupations_data_by_ethnicity_long_by_zip %>%
  group_by(Year, Demographic, WorkerType) %>%
  summarise(Workers = sum(Workers, na.rm=TRUE),
            DemographicWorkers = sum(DemographicWorkers, na.rm=TRUE))
```

# Breaking Down Demographics by ZIP Code
```{r}
collisions_by_zip_code <- collisions_cleaned %>% filter(OccurredYear >= 2016) %>% 
  group_by(COVIDPeriod, Year = OccurredYear, ZIPCode) %>% 
  summarise(
    AnnualCollisions = n(),
    AnnualPedestrianCollisions = sum(CollisionWithPedestrian, na.rm=TRUE),
    AnnualSevereOrFatalInjuries = sum(SevereInjury, na.rm=TRUE) + sum(FatalInjury, na.rm=TRUE)
  ) %>% left_join(census_data %>% mutate(TotalPopulation = MalePopulation + FemalePopulation), 
                  by=c('Year', 'ZIPCode')) %>% 
  left_join(commuting_data, by=c('Year', 'ZIPCode')) %>%
  left_join(commuting_data_by_age, by=c('Year', 'ZIPCode')) %>%
  left_join(commuting_data_by_ethnicity, by=c('Year', 'ZIPCode')) %>%
  left_join(occupations_data, by=c('Year', 'ZIPCode')) %>%
  left_join(occupations_data_by_ethnicity, by=c('Year', 'ZIPCode')) %>%
  mutate(
    OccurredYear = Year,
    COVIDPeriod = factor(COVIDPeriod, levels=c('Pre-COVID', 'During COVID', 'Post-COVID'))) %>%
  ungroup()
```

## Comparing the census and commuter data to collisions data
```{r}
population_rate_box_plots <- function(data_df, demographic_type='', textlabel = demographic_type,
                                      graph_title = paste('Distributions of Population Proportion by ', 
                                                          demographic_type, sep=''),
                                      legend_position='right', text_angle=0, text_hjust=0, text_vjust=0) {
  print(
    data_df %>%
      filter(DemographicType == local(demographic_type),
             Year >= 2016, Year != 2020) %>%
      mutate(COVIDPeriod = ifelse(Year < 2020, 'Pre-COVID', 'Post-COVID') %>%
               factor(levels=c('Pre-COVID', 'Post-COVID'))) %>%
      group_by(COVIDPeriod, ZIPCode, Demographic) %>%
      summarise(AvgPopulation = mean(Population, na.rm=TRUE),
                TotalPopulation = mean(TotalPopulation),
                PopulationProportion = AvgPopulation/TotalPopulation) %>%
      ggplot(aes(x=Demographic, y=PopulationProportion, fill=COVIDPeriod)) +
      geom_boxplot() +
      labs(x=demographic_type, y='Population Proportion', fill='', sep='') +
      theme(legend.position = local(legend_position),
            axis.text.x = element_text(angle=local(text_angle), 
                                       hjust=local(text_hjust), vjust=local(text_vjust))) +
      scale_y_continuous(labels=scales::percent) +
      ggtitle(local(graph_title))
  )
}

commuter_rate_box_plots <- function(data_df, demographic_type='all', textlabel = demographic_type,
                                    graph_title = paste('Box Plots of Population by ', demographic_type, sep=''),
                                    legend_position = 'none', text_angle=0, text_hjust=0, text_vjust=0) {
  print(
    data_df %>%
      filter(DemographicType == local(demographic_type)) %>%
      group_by(ZIPCode, Demographic) %>%
      summarise(AvgPopulation = mean(Population, na.rm=TRUE)) %>%
      ggplot(aes(x=Demographic, y=AvgPopulation, fill=Demographic)) +
      geom_boxplot() +
      labs(x=demographic_type, y='Population', fill='', sep='') +
      theme(legend.position = local(legend_position),
            axis.text.x = element_text(angle=local(text_angle), 
                                       hjust=local(text_hjust), vjust=local(text_vjust))) +
      ggtitle(local(graph_title))
  )
}

```

```{r}
collisions_per_100k_graph <- function(data_df, population='', collision_type='',
                                      textlabel1 = 'Population Proportion', 
                                      textlabel2 = 'Collisions per 100k Population', 
                                      graph_title = paste(textlabel1, 'vs', textlabel2, sep=' '),
                                      victim_threshold = 10, population_threshold = 5000, 
                                      legend_position = 'none') {
  print(
    data_df %>%
      filter(COVIDPeriod != 'During COVID') %>%
      rename(TargetFeature1 = as.symbol(local(population)),
             TargetFeature2 = as.symbol(local(collision_type))) %>%
      group_by(COVIDPeriod, ZIPCode) %>%
      summarise(
        TotalPopulation = mean(TotalPopulation, na.rm=TRUE),
        TargetPopulation = mean(TargetFeature1, na.rm=TRUE),
        AvgAnnualCollisions = mean(TargetFeature2, na.rm=TRUE)
      ) %>%
      filter(AvgAnnualCollisions > local(victim_threshold),
             TotalPopulation >= local(population_threshold)) %>%
      mutate(CollisionsPer100k = 100000*AvgAnnualCollisions/TotalPopulation,
             TargetPopulationProportion = TargetPopulation/TotalPopulation) %>%
      ggplot(aes(x=TargetPopulationProportion, y=CollisionsPer100k, color=COVIDPeriod)) +
      geom_point() +
      labs(x=textlabel1, y=textlabel2, color='', sep='') +
      theme(legend.position = local(legend_position)) +
      facet_wrap(~COVIDPeriod) + 
      ggtitle(local(graph_title), subtitle='Pre- and Post-COVID')
  )
}

proportion_of_total_by_zip_graph <- function(data_df, population='', collision_type='',
                                             textlabel1 = 'Proportion of Population', 
                                             textlabel2 = 'Proportion of Collisions', 
                                             graph_title = paste(textlabel1, 'vs', textlabel2, sep=' '),
                                             victim_threshold = 10, population_threshold = 5000, 
                                             legend_position = 'none') {
  print(
    data_df %>%
      filter(COVIDPeriod != 'During COVID') %>%
      rename(TargetFeature1 = as.symbol(local(population)),
             TargetFeature2 = as.symbol(local(collision_type))) %>%
      group_by(COVIDPeriod, ZIPCode) %>%
      summarise(
        ZIPCodePopulation = mean(TotalPopulation, na.rm=TRUE),
        TargetPopulation = mean(TargetFeature1, na.rm=TRUE),
        AvgAnnualCollisions = mean(TargetFeature2, na.rm=TRUE)
      ) %>%
      group_by(COVIDPeriod) %>% mutate(
        # TotalPopulation = sum(ZIPCodePopulation, na.rm=TRUE),
        TotalTargetPopulation = sum(TargetPopulation, na.rm=TRUE),
        TotalAnnualCollisions = sum(AvgAnnualCollisions, na.rm=TRUE)
      ) %>% ungroup() %>%
      filter(AvgAnnualCollisions > local(victim_threshold),
             ZIPCodePopulation >= local(population_threshold)) %>%
      mutate(ProportionOfCollisions = AvgAnnualCollisions/TotalAnnualCollisions,
             TargetPopulationProportion = TargetPopulation/TotalTargetPopulation) %>%
      ggplot(aes(x=TargetPopulationProportion, y=ProportionOfCollisions, color=COVIDPeriod)) +
      geom_point() +
      labs(x=textlabel1, y=textlabel2, color='', sep='') +
      theme(legend.position = local(legend_position)) +
      facet_wrap(~COVIDPeriod) + 
      ggtitle(local(graph_title), subtitle='Pre-COVID vs Post-COVID')
  )
}
```
